title: Separate-Implementation Verification
description: Separate-implementation verification materials supporting a candidate exclusion of 14-element B_2[2] subsets of Z/100Z. This record contains exactly 13 physical files: three PUBLIC_FIXED compact audit ZIPs, nine FINAL_FIXED byte-preserving transport parts, and P2624_FINAL_FIXED_TRANSPORT_README.txt. Concatenating the nine parts yields the logical 93,453,983-byte P2624_independent_certified_reconstruction_FINAL_FIXED_20260820.zip (SHA-256 83d80155ef4b2dba5a4def970d13317413b763b3447c00a931f4c624b9e45cb5), which is not itself a physical record file. The separate implementation regenerates all seven static lift-tree certificate files with the node counts and per-file SHA-256 values reported by TheoremDB R6090; it is not the unavailable original ZIP. The 219,202,341-byte canonical raw corpus is not in this record and remains at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21988177. The fresh exact replay remains same-project, and TheoremDB P2624 remains Open with official bound 13 <= M <= 14.
notes: Reserved DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22026665; future record URL https://zenodo.org/records/22026665. File-scope licensing applies: author-generated code, scripts, and workflows are MIT; author-generated documentation, data, logs, tables, and manifests are CC BY 4.0; third-party materials remain under their original licenses. Reassemble FINAL_FIXED .00.part through .08.part in numeric suffix order and verify whole-ZIP SHA-256 83d80155ef4b2dba5a4def970d13317413b763b3447c00a931f4c624b9e45cb5; exact part identities are in P2624_FINAL_FIXED_TRANSPORT_README.txt. The canonical raw ZIP is a separate old-record file named B2_Z100_RAW_EVIDENCE_RELEASE_20260818.zip at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21988177 and is not part of these 13 files. Do not call the same-project fresh replay external or state that P2624 is officially resolved.
